Type / origin: Nutrient/aid: inactivated yeast, zinc sulphate, manganese sulphate
Intended use: Fermentation aid for wort with adjuncts; vitality, fewer stuck fermentations
Preparation: Mix in wort or water, add to tank; do not mix with dry yeast during rehydration
Temp: Storage below 24 C under 6 months; below 15 C longer
Key attributes: Improves vitality and attenuation; reduces diacetyl; 36-month shelf life

Intended use: Stable haze in hazy beers (wheat, wit, hazy IPA)
Dose: 5-20 g/hl; 10 g/hl optimal for about 20 EBC
Preparation: Mix in beer or process water; add at start of maturation, not during fermentation
Temp: Disperse at 20-30 C; storage below 24 C under 6 months, below 15 C longer
Key attributes: Protein-polyphenol haze; above 20 g/hl may affect flavor; some proteases reduce effect
